text:
noah: Hey folks :wave: I just tried to open /Shared/Product in Google Drive and got "You need access". Okta shows my user as active but I don't see any group assignments. Also didn't get the 1Password invite. Who should I ping to get baseline access?

it-ops: Welcome Noah — can you confirm the email you used to sign up? Is it noah@redwood.ai or a personal one?

noah: It's noah.h@redwood.ai. I signed up during onboarding link this morning.

it-ops: Got it. Two quick checks: 1) In Okta > Directory > People, open your profile and under "Group memberships" is anything listed? 2) On admin.google.com -> Groups, search for "redwood-product" and see if your email appears.

noah: Okta profile shows: "Groups: —" (empty). I can't access admin.google.com.

marta: I provisioned the account earlier but I think our Okta->G Suite sync missed some groups for a batch this morning. I'll requeue a sync; IT will need to re-assign the "redwood-employees" and "redwood-product" groups.

alexdev: FYI sometimes the 1Password invite is blocked by our invite throttling if the user is missing the org group. IT can force-invite from 1Password Admin -> People -> Invite -> enter email.

it-ops: On it. Requeued the group sync and manually added noah.h@redwood.ai to redwood-employees and redwood-product. Also forced resend of 1Password invite. Should take ~5 minutes to propagate.

onboard-bot: Account creation event: user=noah.h@redwood.ai status=provisioning groups=updated ts=1843509732

noah: I got the 1Password invite now, thanks. Drive access still gives "You need access" though.

liz: Try opening the Drive link in an incognito window or clear cache — Drive sometimes caches permissions with our SSO cookies. If still blocked, can you paste a screenshot?

noah: Incognito worked! I can see the folder now. Everything looks in order. Thanks for the fast turnaround :tada: 

it-ops: Great — caching + sync race was the likely cause. I've added a step to our onboarding runbook to double-check group syncs after batch provisioning. Filing follow-up ticket: IT-1234.

sam: Welcome aboard, Noah! Ping me if you want a quick tour of the Product Drive content or the onboarding checklist. :coffee:
